notes.title: Update 0.14
notes.content: [p]1. Optimized FPS for smoother and more stable gameplay.[/p][p]2. Added more realistic sound effects for better immersion.[/p][p]3. Some sprites have been redrawn or replaced.[/p][p]4. Increased bullet and projectile speed for faster combat.[/p][p]5. Camera control completely changed — now scrolling is done by holding the middle mouse button.[/p][p]6. Chemical cloud dissipates faster, improving visibility.[/p][p]7. New unit added: PMC Mortar Operator — long-range support. Available after researching in the tech tree.[/p][p]8. New mode: Survival — hold out as long as possible against waves of enemies.[/p][p]9. Added destructible buildings and new decorative elements.[/p][p]10. Added fuel barrels that explode when shot.[/p][p]11. Added dunes and protrusions on the map that provide tactical advantages in battle.[/p][p]12. Removed resources such as "wood" and "research points".[/p][p]13. Tech tree now unlocks using in-game currency.[/p][p]14. Added a market that automatically sells oil.[/p][p]15. Tech tree structure has been redesigned for better usability.[/p][p]16. Enemy AI improved:[/p][p]   - Engineers now build and reinforce the base,[/p][p]   - Defense is immediately strengthened when oil fields are captured.[/p][p]17. Added random terrain generation for unique maps every game.[/p][p]18. Metal cover objects (barrels, abandoned vehicles, etc.) can now be penetrated by bullets.[/p][p]19. When building fortifications (HESCO and brick blocks), they automatically connect for stronger defense.[/p][p]20. Unit selection UI now shows class icons to simplify choosing the right squads.[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.13
notes.content:
After a long break, I want to make a small update.
Due to political issues, it was not possible to continue development of the game.

[list]
[*] Sound and visual effects have been improved, more time is devoted to sound effects, the sound of war becomes more voluminous and realistic.
[*] The technology tree has been translated into English and French
[*] Resource icons have been added to the descriptions of buildings
[*] In the sandbox you can now place soldiers on fortifications
[/list]

Campaign for PMCs in development

Thanks to all those who support by purchasing and adding to the wishlist. Peace to you!
